sourceBaseline.algorithm: SHA-256 exact current raw source bytes

reviewMethod: All 77 exact audit identities were compared with the original feature record, current PDP-0 capability outcomes/unsupported cases, requirement acceptance cases, exact proposal refs/cases, and prior row findings. Findings evaluate proposal semantics only.

exactSourceFeature.text: Offline ASR transcription and local model routing
exactSourceFeature.acceptanceText: CPU and GPU speech observations produce source-clock word spans, language, effective model, scores and honest uncertainty; no synthetic transcript qualifies.

canonicalCapabilityEvidence.outcome: File transcription is represented by a tracking reference and, if produced, an unverified transcript draft linked to the source version/timebase with provided language or recognition evidence. When explicitly requested and admitted, transcription may use a versioned custom glossary for recognition or correction and may return uncertain source-anchored filler-word or retake candidates. Glossary guidance is distinct from punctuation/capitalization formatting; filler/retake candidates are distinct from silence observations and do not alter the source.
explicitUnsupportedCases: No implicit supported-language list, default locale, confidence threshold, speaker identification, diarization guarantee, file duration/size, sample-rate, or provider is defined here.
No claim that returned transcript text is human-verified, an accessible caption, or a registered caption version.
acceptanceCaseThen: The response returns one durable job identity and the requested operation/profile version without claiming a transcript is complete or verified.
The result preserves source version/timebase, labels recognized text as unverified, scopes uncertainty to supplied evidence, and exposes a review path.
The operation blocks or returns only a permitted partial result with explicit limitation; no language or speaker identity is invented.

canonicalRequirementEvidence.statement: Every operation in media.speech.transcription retains the intended semantic outcome in the full product definition and is invocable only through an explicit, authorized, compatible binding whose current implementation, license admission, qualification, and runtime availability are separately established.
canonicalRequirementEvidence.expectedBehavior: The system performs only the requested File and streaming STT; language detection; voice-activity detection; speaker diarization, segmentation and separation; authorized speaker identification; word and phoneme timestamps; forced alignment; punctuation/capitalization; alternatives and confidence; speech translation; subtitle generation operation using typed inputs and outputs; reports actual effective parameters and provenance; preserves source versions; and does not substitute an unsupported engine, model, format, language, or delivery profile silently.
failureDegradationRecovery: Return typed validation, authority, rights/license, unsupported-capability, capacity, timeout, cancellation, provider-ambiguity, and internal-failure outcomes as applicable.
Expose safe remediation, retry/cancel/reconcile eligibility, and finality; do not silently downgrade preservation, quality, spatial/scientific fidelity, or delivery constraints.
Preserve accepted source and completed outputs; require policy-permitted explicit fallback or stop for review.

citedParentCases.given: A declared leaf, authorized input, and a binding that satisfies the requested profile and policy.
citedParentCases.when: The caller requests the operation.
citedParentCases.then: The typed result, effective parameters, provenance, terminal/finality state, and measured dimensions are returned; only the declared effect occurs.

citedParentCases.given: The requested language, format, right, profile, license, capability, or qualification is absent or unknown.
citedParentCases.when: Admission is evaluated.
citedParentCases.then: The operation is blocked or returns an explicit qualified fallback only when policy permits; unknown is never reported as available.

citedParentCases.given: A user explicitly initiates dictation and selects a target that is authorized by the operating system.
citedParentCases.when: the product inserts the resulting dictated text into that selected target.
citedParentCases.then: limit capture and insertion to the user-initiated session and selected OS-authorized target; report unavailable when permission or the required adapter is missing.
citedParentCases.rejection: reject background or global capture/insertion, choosing an unselected target, or bypassing denied or unavailable permission.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized source version and an admitted, versioned custom glossary are supplied for transcription.
citedParentCases.when: Glossary-guided recognition or correction is requested.
citedParentCases.then: Return any produced transcript as an unverified, source-version/timebase-linked draft and identify the glossary version used; keep this operation distinct from punctuation and capitalization.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject silently applying an ambiguous, unsupported, or unavailable glossary entry, or claiming that glossary guidance verifies transcript correctness.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized source version is admitted for speech transcription and filler/retake analysis.
citedParentCases.when: The actor requests ASR-assisted filler-word or retake detection.
citedParentCases.then: Return only uncertain candidate observations anchored to the exact source version and time range, distinct from silence observations.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject classifying silence alone as a filler or retake, or automatically deleting, trimming, or cutting source content from a candidate observation.

citedParentCases.given: A user requests translation of a source speech or transcript version to a declared target locale and supplies any translation-memory or brand-glossary references and approved term entries available for that request.
citedParentCases.when: The translation operation is evaluated and, if admitted, prepares a translated draft.
citedParentCases.then: Apply only admitted, versioned, approved, unambiguous, applicable source/target term pairs or do-not-translate entries; preserve the memory and glossary versions and identify which protected terms were retained. Present translated content as a draft, not as approved or verified text. For an otherwise admitted translation request with a missing or unavailable memory or glossary, explicitly report that it was not applied; do not silently substitute another entry, glossary, or translation behavior. If a supplied memory or glossary is denied, stale, ambiguous, conflicting, or unknown, report that state; if source authorization or rights are denied or unknown, block the operation under the family admission behavior in MEDIA-REQ-CAP-SPEECH-TRANSCRIPTION-AC-02 with no fallback. For any dubbed result, preserve every supplied per-segment speaker, locale, source-timing, and translation-provenance field. If a field is not supplied or cannot be established, identify it as absent or unknown rather than silently omitting or fabricating it; mark a field not applicable only with an explicit reason. This case does not establish audio/video export synchronization, which remains a separate requirement.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject changing a term marked do-not-translate, silently omitting an unresolved protected term, applying an unversioned, unapproved, or inapplicable entry, resolving conflicting entries by silent preference, or describing a translated draft as owner-approved or verified.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized microphone recording session and an admitted transcription request refer to the same exact captured source version.
citedParentCases.when: The product prepares a transcript draft or paired archive candidate.
citedParentCases.then: Link the transcript to the source version, capture session, and timebase while retaining the recording as an independently identifiable immutable artifact.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject implying archive registration, changing either artifact without separate authorization, or claiming a resolved pair when source identity or alignment is unknown.

candidatePdp0Case.given: Authorized exact audio version, purpose, consent, and explicit local-only request.
candidatePdp0Case.when: Evaluate the exact local profile/model route.
candidatePdp0Case.then: Return a tracking reference and an unverified source-linked draft only if that exact local route is admitted; otherwise UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN. Never route local-only requests remotely.
negativeCases: No default local model/provider/language/CPU/GPU support.
Denied/unknown rights block; no synthetic transcript.
candidatePdp0Case.upstreamBoundaries: PDP-1 owns route identity/state; BUILD/DELIVER own local execution and qualification.

rows.proposalRationale: VAD covers voice temporal observations, and content-kind distinguishes speech/music/non-speech, but no source defines silence as a separate interval outcome.
rows.semanticComparison: R2 mentions voice, silence, non-speech and UNKNOWN, but binds only voice activity. Exact silence-detection and content-kind leaves also exist, so this is a three-leaf coverage issue before any residual is classified as new P0 meaning.
rows.requiredCorrection: Bind voice-activity, silence-detection, and content-kind separately; define source/version/time coverage and UNKNOWN per leaf. Keep finer sound-event taxonomy unresolved absent exact source evidence.
rows.acceptanceCriterion: Each claimed class is bound to its exact observing leaf; missing coverage stays UNKNOWN, never silence.
nonClaims: No owner decision or authorization is asserted.
No independent PDP acceptance/closure is asserted.
No implementation, runtime availability, qualification, or release is asserted.

priorFinding.sourceDefect: `media.speech.transcription.language.detect` defines a language observation, but the feature also promises mixed-language segments. The cited family cases do not define segment boundaries, per-segment language, or uncertainty for mixed/ambiguous speech.
priorFinding.repair: Add a source-grounded feature case for segment-level language observations, or narrow the P0 mapping to language detection and preserve segment partitioning as a later-phase handoff.
priorFinding.acceptanceCriterion: Given exact source/time scope, when languages vary within speech, return source-time-bounded language observations or explicit UNKNOWN; do not infer a single language or precise boundaries without evidence.

citedParentCases.then: The typed result, effective parameters, provenance, terminal/finality state, and measured dimensions are returned; only the declared effect occurs.

citedParentCases.given: The requested language, format, right, profile, license, capability, or qualification is absent or unknown.
citedParentCases.when: Admission is evaluated.
citedParentCases.then: The operation is blocked or returns an explicit qualified fallback only when policy permits; unknown is never reported as available.

citedParentCases.given: An actor is authorized to search transcript content for an exact source-media or project version.
citedParentCases.when: The actor requests a semantic transcript search.
citedParentCases.then: Return bounded candidate matches anchored to the exact source version and transcript time range; distinguish unavailable transcript content, denied scope, unknown matching, and an empty candidate page.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject presenting candidates as complete when matching or continuation is unknown, or returning transcript content outside the admitted rights-and-retention scope.

citedParentCases.given: An actor is authorized to inspect possible duplicate or near-duplicate artifacts.
citedParentCases.when: the actor requests duplicate detection.
citedParentCases.then: Return bounded candidate groups that retain every source artifact identity and state the matching uncertainty.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject merging, replacing, or deleting any source artifact as a consequence of candidate detection.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized Studio creator searches the governed Media asset store for candidates for an explicitly declared intended-use scope.
citedParentCases.when: The product evaluates each immutable asset version for the requested license/use-scope filter.
citedParentCases.then: Return a candidate as eligible only when current authoritative per-version rights and license evidence explicitly permits the declared scope; preserve the exact asset version and evidence identity. Missing, unknown, denied, expired, revoked, restricted, or incompatible evidence never makes a candidate eligible, and unresolved evidence is reported as UNKNOWN or review-required rather than as an empty eligible result.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject inferring permission from searchable metadata, treating this filter as legal clearance, silently substituting a different asset or license, or claiming external-catalog search, ranking, or complete results.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor searches an admitted project for timeline, person, scene, or speaker facets with an explicit time range and exact project or source-version scope.
citedParentCases.when: The product evaluates the requested facet filters against indexed observations.
citedParentCases.then: Return bounded matches with exact immutable source-version references, matching time ranges, and observed or inferred provenance; report unknown or unindexed fields and partial matching separately from a known empty result.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject presenting an unindexed or uncertain facet as absent, claiming complete matches while continuation or indexing is unknown, or widening the search beyond authorized rights and retention scope.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized creator submits a visual or descriptive metadata query for assets within an explicit project and version scope.
citedParentCases.when: The product searches available visual observations and metadata.
citedParentCases.then: Return bounded candidate matches with exact source-version provenance, relevant time ranges where available, and match uncertainty; distinguish unavailable or unindexed evidence and unknown matching from a known empty result.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject representing similarity as a verified fact, dropping source-version provenance, claiming completeness when indexing or continuation is unknown, or exposing content outside admitted rights and retention scope.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor imports a sidecar or embedded caption track for an exact immutable media version and the format and rights are admitted.
citedParentCases.when: The product parses and validates the caption source and its timebase mapping.
citedParentCases.then: Return a reviewable caption-import result preserving source-file provenance, source version, language and format when known, caption timing, and any conversion or alignment uncertainty; do not alter the source media.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting or dropping caption timing, claiming unknown language or alignment as verified, or registering or replacing a canonical artifact without the separately authorized action.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor requests a clip derived from an exact immutable source version with an explicit source-time range, output profile, purpose, and applicable rights.
citedParentCases.when: The product validates the range against the source timebase and prepares the derivation.
citedParentCases.then: Bind the candidate derivation to the exact source version and requested start and end times, disclose boundary quantization or uncertainty, and return job or candidate state without changing the source.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject substituting another source version, silently rounding or extending the requested range, implying a completed or registered artifact before that state is confirmed, or bypassing rights and profile admission.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized user searches the governed Media asset store by declared metadata and an intended-use rights scope.
citedParentCases.when: The product evaluates exact asset versions against available metadata and authoritative per-version rights evidence.
citedParentCases.then: Return bounded candidates with exact version and rights-evidence references; distinguish unknown or incomplete indexing from a known empty result. External catalogs are available only when a specific catalog and use are separately admitted.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject inferring permission from searchable metadata, calling search legal clearance, or claiming external-catalog, complete, or ranked results when those scopes are not admitted.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor supplies a source timecode with its exact source version, declared frame rate or timebase, and drop-frame or non-drop-frame mode.
citedParentCases.when: The product interprets or converts that timecode.
citedParentCases.then: Preserve the original label and mode and return an exact source-time mapping only when the declared rate, mode, and mapping are valid.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject ambiguous or invalid labels, mismatched rates, unknown mappings, silent drop-frame/non-drop-frame reinterpretation, or rounding across frame boundaries.

rows.proposalRationale: Rebind to an exact source/profile/output derivative candidate; the profile and output type must name the requested proxy, and no dispatch/persistence/completion is claimed.

citedParentCases.rejection: reject hidden or background microphone capture, continuing capture after the user ends the session, representing partial or uncertain recognition as confirmed input, or reporting a complete response when the outcome is unknown or unavailable.

citedParentCases.when: Media prepares the requested speech artifact and audiobook package.

citedParentCases.rejection: Reject flattening or reordering supplied boundaries, inventing chapter metadata, silently substituting a format or voice, or representing candidate metadata as proof of qualified format support, completed audio, or delivery.

citedParentCases.when: Media prepares speech for those segments as one continuous work.
citedParentCases.then: Represent the declared segment order and shared context/profile as requested candidate properties; report continuity as established only for segments where the admitted operation establishes it, and expose other segments as denied, unsupported, or unknown. citedParentCases.rejection: Reject claiming cross-segment continuity from unrelated or missing context, silently changing the declared profile, or treating an unavailable or unknown continuity result as established or guaranteeing audible identity/continuity.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized creator supplies an ordered story or speech plan with explicit segment boundaries and an authorized speaker assignment for each segment.

citedParentCases.then: Preserve segment order and boundaries, bind each segment to its exact authorized speaker and applicable rights evidence, and return per-segment voice, source, and generated-audio provenance with any unavailable assignment marked explicitly.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject using a speaker without current authorization for the segment and purpose, silently substituting a voice or reordering segments, or claiming a generated artifact is committed when it is only a candidate.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized synthesis request pins the exact requested speaker or voice, model/checkpoint, profile, worker, and source version for the declared purpose.

citedParentCases.then: Report requested and observed speaker/voice, model/checkpoint, profile, worker, and source identities separately for the exact output; preserve mismatch or unobserved identity as UNKNOWN and retain the output as synthetic media.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting a speaker, voice, model, checkpoint, profile, or worker; inferring the effective identity from the request alone; or treating a configured identity as proof of the output's authorship, rights, or authenticity.

citedParentCases.given: A creator declares quality priorities, a hard resource budget, and the low/high or other pipeline choices for a source version.

citedParentCases.then: Present every declared choice with its quality dimensions, resource estimates, assumptions, and feasible, infeasible, denied, unavailable, or unknown status; preserve the user's explicit selection in a version-bound candidate plan. If the selected choice violates the budget or required quality constraints, mark that selection infeasible and request a new explicit selection even when another choice is feasible. Never auto-switch choices, execute the plan, exceed the budget, silently downgrade quality, or substitute another pipeline.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject representing estimates as measured quality or resource use, changing the selected tradeoff without an explicit request, or presenting a candidate plan as authorization, qualification, or completed processing.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor requests highlight candidates from an exact source version and declares the selection objective, eligible source-time interval, and any ranking dimensions and weights.
citedParentCases.when: The product evaluates source-grounded evidence and ranks candidate spans.
citedParentCases.then: Return each highlight as an exact source-time candidate with evidence, uncertainty, and the declared objective and ranking inputs; abstain or report unknown when evidence is insufficient and do not assign a default memorable or engagement score.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject claiming a highlight is objectively memorable, ranking with an undeclared objective or hidden weights, or omitting the exact source version and time span.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized creator requests variants for declared audiences and channels from an exact source candidate and supplies the comparison objective and any ranking dimensions and weights.
citedParentCases.when: The product prepares or compares the audience- and channel-specific variants.
citedParentCases.then: Bind each variant to the exact source candidate, audience, channel, and applicable profile; expose declared ranking inputs and uncertainty, and return no ranking when the objective or required evidence is absent.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject silently changing the source candidate or target audience/channel, inferring a universal preference score, or presenting a ranking produced by undeclared criteria.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor declares a project revision, B-roll purpose, exact eligible source versions, and selection objective.
citedParentCases.when: Media recommends B-roll candidates for the project.
citedParentCases.then: Return reviewable candidates with exact source version and source-time span, supporting evidence, uncertainty, and rights decision reference; do not attach a candidate to the project.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject treating a recommendation as source acceptance or project mutation; missing or unknown rights or source-time evidence makes the candidate ineligible or unresolved.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized reviewer evaluates a QA claim that includes a product or business-state assertion.
citedParentCases.when: Media reports the QA result.
citedParentCases.then: Separate media-quality observations from authoritative owner-system readback and bind any state assertion to the exact owner reference, revision, and observation time.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject substituting a media score, decoded output, execution log, or job acknowledgment for owner readback; absent or stale readback remains UNKNOWN and blocks the business-state claim.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized reviewer submits exact versioned audio source and candidate references for an admitted, bounded content-similarity observation with a declared method and comparison scope.
citedParentCases.when: Media performs the requested audio fingerprint or similarity observation.
citedParentCases.then: Return the observation status, method/version, comparison scope, exact input identities, provenance, uncertainty, and any candidate match as non-authoritative review data; retain a separate rights-policy decision for every proposed use and exact checkpoint/license admission for generated music, including commercial-use incompatibility.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject inferring ownership, infringement, license, permission, legal clearance, or definitive identity from similarity; missing or unknown inputs, method, transformation scope, or authority cannot become a positive finding.

rows.proposalRationale: Rebind to read-only, dimension-scoped comparison observation and supplied comparison basis; human-readable view presentation remains PDP-2.
rows.semanticComparison: For 'Human-readable visual comparison view', the proposal binds only the exact declared capability/result or a bounded source-grounded candidate and preserves unsupported scope in its rationale/handoffs. The concrete feature, acceptance text, canonical outcomes, cases and proposed refs below were reviewed. PASS is agreement with proposal scope only.
rows.acceptanceCriterion: AUD-COLOR-017: exact source feature semantics are bound to a declared PDP-0 result; unsupported dimensions remain UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE; no execution, acceptance or qualification is inferred.
nonClaims: No owner decision or authorization is asserted.
No independent PDP acceptance/closure is asserted.
No implementation, runtime availability, qualification, or release is asserted.

priorFinding.sourceDefect: `media.compose.render-manifest` yields a local manifest/configuration candidate, not a source-time rational-frame render graph. Rational time semantics alone do not define graph nodes, dependencies, or graph outcome.
priorFinding.repair: Narrow the P0 meaning to a render-manifest candidate and preserve graph/timebase structure for its owning PDP-1 definition; do not assert graph coverage from the manifest leaf.
priorFinding.acceptanceCriterion: Manifest inputs/configuration are distinct from a resolved graph and from rendered output; unresolved dependencies/time mapping remain UNKNOWN.

exactSourceFeature.text: Source-time rational-frame render graph
exactSourceFeature.acceptanceText: Every export profile is negotiated against the actual encoder/container/OS; output is decoded and checked before completion claims, and unsupported codecs stay unavailable.

canonicalCapabilityEvidence.outcome: P0 defines the create render manifest result as a local composition candidate or draft whose intended operation is to describe the composition inputs and render configuration in a manifest; it does not define a committed project change or rendered delivery.
explicitUnsupportedCases: Any unqualified language, format, size, output dimension, physical/scientific regime, identity/likeness use, provider, license, locality, or profile.
Any unsupported parameter value or combination; do not substitute silently.
acceptanceCaseThen: The result is typed, traceable, and bounded; actual outputs and unsupported/estimated dimensions are disclosed.
Execution is blocked or the request receives only an explicitly policy-permitted fallback; no support or finality is fabricated.

canonicalRequirementEvidence.statement: Every operation in media.compose retains the intended semantic outcome in the full product definition and is invocable only through an explicit, authorized, compatible binding whose current implementation, license admission, qualification, and runtime availability are separately established.
canonicalRequirementEvidence.expectedBehavior: The system performs only the requested Multitrack timelines; scene/storyboard assembly; video/audio/caption/overlay tracks; transitions; titles/credits/lower thirds; exact typography/logos/brand assets; safe areas; reusable compositions and render manifests operation using typed inputs and outputs; reports actual effective parameters and provenance; preserves source versions; and does not substitute an unsupported engine, model, format, language, or delivery profile silently.
failureDegradationRecovery: Return typed validation, authority, rights/license, unsupported-capability, capacity, timeout, cancellation, provider-ambiguity, and internal-failure outcomes as applicable.
Expose safe remediation, retry/cancel/reconcile eligibility, and finality; do not silently downgrade preservation, quality, spatial/scientific fidelity, or delivery constraints.
Preserve accepted source and completed outputs; require policy-permitted explicit fallback or stop for review.

citedParentCases.given: A declared leaf, authorized input, and a binding that satisfies the requested profile and policy.
citedParentCases.when: The caller requests the operation.
citedParentCases.then: The typed result, effective parameters, provenance, terminal/finality state, and measured dimensions are returned; only the declared effect occurs.

citedParentCases.given: The requested language, format, right, profile, license, capability, or qualification is absent or unknown.
citedParentCases.when: Admission is evaluated.
citedParentCases.then: The operation is blocked or returns an explicit qualified fallback only when policy permits; unknown is never reported as available.

citedParentCases.given: An actor requests an active-speaker-aware multicamera cut proposal from admitted speaker-turn and camera-source observations.
citedParentCases.when: The product prepares the proposal.
citedParentCases.then: Return a reviewable local candidate that links each proposed cut to its speaker-turn and camera-source evidence and makes uncertainty explicit.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject inferring missing speaker/camera evidence or committing the proposal to the project without an explicit separate approval.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact audio-track versions and declares gain, pan, and time-varying automation points with a timebase and project revision.
citedParentCases.when: The product prepares the multitrack edit.
citedParentCases.then: Return a local reviewable candidate that preserves track and source-version identities, records the requested automation points and any validation uncertainty, and leaves project state unchanged until explicit confirmation.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject collapsing automation to an undocumented static value, mutating the project or source audio before confirmation, or implying a rendered output from the candidate.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor selects an exact speech source version and specifies a sample-time region edit, including intended boundaries and any crossfade parameters.
citedParentCases.when: The product prepares the speech edit against the declared sample rate and timebase.
citedParentCases.then: Return a reviewable local candidate with exact source-version and sample-boundary references, disclose boundary quantization or crossfade validation uncertainty, and preserve the source and project revision.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting boundaries, inventing crossfade values, modifying the source, or claiming the candidate has been rendered or committed.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor requests overlay placement in apparent free space for an exact source version and time interval.
citedParentCases.when: The product evaluates detected free-space evidence and prepares a placement suggestion.
citedParentCases.then: Return an uncertain local placement candidate tied to the exact source version, time range, declared overlay, and detection context, preserving the evidence and allowing review before any composition change.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject presenting detected free space as guaranteed safe or unobstructed, omitting uncertainty or source-time context, or applying or rendering the placement without explicit authorization.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized creator selects a branded motion template and supplies typed editable parameters bound to identified brand assets and a project revision.
citedParentCases.when: The product instantiates the template as a composition proposal.
citedParentCases.then: Return an editable local candidate that identifies the template version, each typed parameter and its binding, exact source and brand-asset versions, and unresolved parameter constraints; leave the project unchanged pending review and confirmation.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting brand assets or parameter values, claiming preview or render parity without evidence, or committing the proposal before confirmation.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor has a take intent classified as captured ADR, generated narration, or captured or generated room tone, with exact source or session provenance and a declared timeline location.
citedParentCases.when: The product prepares placement in the multitrack composition.
citedParentCases.then: Return a reviewable local placement candidate that preserves the content-origin distinction, exact source or generation provenance, intended time range, and any alignment uncertainty without mutating the project.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject relabeling generated narration as captured ADR, treating a recording intent as captured content, conflating captured and generated room tone, or committing or rendering the edit without explicit authorization.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor declares protected text or logo regions on an exact source version, or detection evidence for those regions is uncertain.
citedParentCases.when: Media prepares an overlay or reframe candidate.
citedParentCases.then: Preserve declared protected regions or mark the candidate unresolved for review, retaining source-version and time-range evidence.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject claiming protected content is preserved when region evidence is absent or uncertain, changing the source, or committing the candidate without confirmation.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor declares a target aspect ratio, exact source version, time range, and eligible subject evidence for automatic framing.
citedParentCases.when: Media prepares a subject-aware framing candidate.
citedParentCases.then: Bind the candidate to the declared target and source-time evidence and disclose uncertainty and any crop or excluded source region.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject claiming all subjects or content remain in frame when evidence is uncertain, silently changing aspect ratio, or modifying or rendering the source without confirmation.

citedParentCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact track versions and declares track-to-bus assignments, send routing, pre/post-fader position, and any bus or track effect-chain version for one project revision.
citedParentCases.when: Media prepares the multitrack routing candidate.
citedParentCases.then: Return a local, reviewable routing graph that preserves the declared assignments, routing, gain/pan/automation, effect-chain identities, and source versions and exposes unresolved compatibility; leave the project and audio unchanged pending explicit confirmation.
citedParentCases.rejection: Reject inferred routing or effect values, cycles or unsupported graphs, silent track/bus substitution, source mutation, project commit, rendering, export, or qualified loudness/true-peak claims.

candidatePdp0Case.then: Return a versioned manifest candidate that preserves exact source-version references and rational time mappings for each declared track/segment; distinguish graph description from render execution.
